request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Dolos by TxPipe: Maintaining Cardano's Lightweight Data Node, Year 2.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Dolos maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
The total withdrawal is 540,750 ADA, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Dolos maintenance and enhancement and 15,750 ADA for the Intersect budget administration fee.
Dolos is described as a lightweight Cardano data node in Rust that provides efficient chain-data access without the overhead of traditional full nodes.
Dolos exposes five query interfaces, including Mini-Blockfrost HTTP, UTxO-RPC gRPC, Mini-Kupo, and an Ouroboros N2C unix socket compatible with existing Cardano tooling.
The proposal states Dolos has 939 commits, 80 releases, 129 stars, 51 forks, and 27 contributors.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposer states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
TxPipe is stated to have received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule.

Independent oversight is described as being provided through Intersect and third parties, with milestone-based disbursement controls and smart contract permissions requiring multiple Intersect, leadership, and external trusted-entity approvals.
The proposal states a public dashboard and on-chain smart contract framework will allow the community to audit and track the withdrawn ADA.

summary: The document requests 540,750 ADA through Intersect to fund 12 months of Dolos maintenance by TxPipe, with stated open-source infrastructure benefits, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, prior funding disclosures, and smart-contract-based oversight and tracking.
